output.reasoning: Two hard criteria fail. Location: the posting is London, UK with a GBP salary (£225,000–£255,000), and it is neither US-based nor marked Remote. The hybrid policy requires staff in an office at least 25% of the time. Ananya is in Boston, MA, and her willingness to relocate covers the US only. Level: the posting explicitly asks for 4+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or technical founder, which exceeds the 3-year cap. Ananya is a new grad (MS CS AI concentration at Boston University, ending 2026-12) with one 8-month ML Engineer co-op. Role type is only a partial fit. The title is AI Engineer and the work includes hands-on prototyping and building LLM applications, which overlaps with her RAG and evaluation work. However, the role is heavily customer-facing and pre-sales: technical advisor, workshops, hackathons, and travel to customer sites, with prior customer-facing experience required. Skills test: the required section names only Python as a specific technology (fewer than 2), so the skills test is skipped. Sponsorship passes, since the posting states 'We do sponsor visas!' and she needs sponsorship, but this cannot outweigh the location and level failures.
